meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill for omo-senpi. Self-orchestrates a 5-member hostile team (categories unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via the native lead team tools for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the insights that survive the attacks, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled bundle to a planner task (load_skills ulw-plan) for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用对抗式辩论打磨规划方案

howto.what: 启用后,Claude会组建一支5人的“对抗评审团”,让不同立场的成员互相攻击、挑刺各自提出的方案;只有扛过攻击的想法才会被保留,最后交给专门的规划器整理成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“adversarial plan”等触发词,或要求进行对抗式、高强度严谨性规划时触发。

say.text: 对这个重构方案做一次对抗式评审。
say.note: 成员会互相攻击方案弱点,只留下经得起推敲的部分。

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude orchestrates a 5-member hostile review team whose members attack each other's proposals; only ideas that survive the attacks are kept, then handed to a dedicated planner to formalize an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say keywords like 'hyperplan' or 'adversarial plan', or ask for adversarial / maximum-rigor planning.

Run an adversarial review on this refactor plan.
